title: Rex and the Firehouse with Two Red Doors
synopsis: Rex, Gus and Jack discover the firehouse on Station Lane, meet Captain Ann, and learn that its two red vehicles have different jobs.
continuity_state: Before: Season Six ended with Jack recording the rain route and resetting the park rain gauge. The park, farm, pedestrian bridge, garage and delivery route remain as established. The firehouse has not yet appeared on Jack's map. After: A standing firehouse with two red bay doors is established on Station Lane, a short northward street off Brook Road between Rex's house and Pine Park. Captain Ann, an adult fox firefighter, meets Rex, Gus and Jack. One bay holds a pumper engine; the other holds a longer aerial ladder truck. An open day is announced for the coming weekend.
